answer: Identity bond natural decay blocks bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond shrinking 5% each epoch without verified work, so a cipher key buys no lasting standing. The ledger is a mirror: bonds and forfeits are public, and identical new bonds are flagged together; a lapsed bond leaves a sable mark warning others. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA, decay leaving nothing to recover. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
